page.overview:
What is Spear?

A spear was a shaft with a blade placed on the top, a melee weapon typically used by primitive species like the Aeosians, Ewoks, Poletecs, and Talz.

The Elite Praetorian Guard of the First Order wielded advanced spear-like weapons like the electro-bisento and vibro-voulges. Captain Phasma also wielded a baton that resembled a spear when unfurled.

Star Wars Epic Yarns: Return of the Jedi
